plan: A rune mage who chains his spells very quickly and can teleport his team.
aSurveiller: His W (Rune Prison). He slows or roots you if you are marked: dodge his E, which marks.
contrer: Engage him when his spells are on cooldown.
Avoid his E: the mark lets his W root you.
Watch his R: he can teleport his team.

sorts.P: More damage thanks to his mana.
sorts.Q: Projectile that resets with his other spells.
sorts.W: Slows or roots a marked target.
